observed_public_api_contract.documented_local_copy_operation: Users may retrieve all data associated with a Schedule and download it to local storage for their own systems or databases.
observed_public_api_contract.api_schedule_scope: Current effective schedule data; every effective schedule for the most recent 12 months is available.

rights_observation.interpretation: Official documentation expressly supports downloading schedule data to local storage for a user's own systems or databases. It does not specify a retention duration or external redistribution licence. This supports the documented local-copy workflow but does not resolve the project's B2 retention period, source-byte redistribution, derived public release, or separate source-specific maintainer decision.

next_action: Use the documented local-copy workflow only after a source-specific maintainer rights decision defines internal retention; obtain provider clarification for retention duration and external redistribution before retaining beyond that scope or publishing. No API data payload has been requested or acquired.
boundary: This is a metadata-only rights preflight. It does not change acquisition authorization, qualify PBS domain semantics or M-109, establish Bronze landing, or authorize publication.
